[[File:Sophia.png|thumb|250px|Sophia]] [[File:Young Sophia.png|thumb|left|220px|Sophia 50 years ago]] '''Sophia''' (Japanese: '''ソフィア''' ''Sophia'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP187|Moving Pictures]]'', She lives with her husband of 50 years, [[Marcello]], at the [[Sunflora Lodge]], which they run together. Sophia and Marcello married 50 years ago and took a picture with hundreds of {{p|Sunflora}}. They continued this tradition for the next 49 wedding anniversaries. On their 50th anniversary, however, the weather was particularly cold and the Sunflora never appeared at the usual south slope location. {{Ash}} was able to use his [[Sun Stone]] that he won as a prize in the [[Bug-Catching Contest]] to evolve a recently rescued {{p|Sunkern}} into a Sunflora. This Sunflora went on to call the other Sunflora over, allowing Sophia and Marcello to maintain their anniversary tradition, and {{Todd}} took the commemorative snapshot. Sophia enjoys telling travelers romantic stories about herself and Marcello. However, these tales aren't completely true and are inspired by the many romance novels and movies she enjoys. ==Pokémon== ===Befriended=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sophia |pkmn=Sunflora |stage1=Sunkern |type1=Grass |img=Sunkern anime.png |img2=Sunflora EP187.png |epnum=EP187 |epname=Moving Pictures |vaen=Rachel Lillis |desc=Sophia befriended a {{p|Sunflora}} when it was still a {{p|Sunkern}}. It first appeared when Ash, {{ashfr}}, and {{Todd}} spotted a frozen Sunkern. They took it to the [[Sunflora Lodge]], where Sophia nursed it back to health. Later, when {{TRT}} caused havoc with one of their machines, Sunkern used {{m|Sunny Day}} to melt the snow created by the machine. Ash and his friends were sure that the Sunflora would come now, but they still did not. Ash then remembered the [[Sun Stone]] he won in the [[Bug-Catching Contest]] and used it to evolve Sunkern into a Sunflora. The newly evolved Sunflora called hundreds of Sunflora over to pose for Sophia and [[Marcello]]'s 50th anniversary photo. Sunflora's only known move is {{m|Sunny Day}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sophia |pkmn=Sunflora (multiple) |type1=Grass |img=Multiple Sunflora anime.png |cap=Sophia's Sunflora |epnum=EP187 |epname=Moving Pictures |vaen=Rachel Lillis |desc=Over the years, Sophia and her husband [[Marcello]] had befriended multiple {{p|Sunflora}} after taking a wedding picture with a field of Sunflora behind them. The flowery and bright backdrop led Sophia and Marcello to start a tradition of taking such photos during their wedding anniversary for the next 49 years. The couple's 50th anniversary was threatened because of the cold weather in the area. However, a Sunflora, which {{Ash}} just evolved, called hundreds of other Sunflora, allowing Sophia and Marcello to take the photo.
